steps.en: Install the package and set your model key
Declare agents with instructions, function tools and who they may hand off to
steps.zh: 声明智能体：指令、函数工具、可以转交给谁

steps.en: Start a run with the first agent and the user input
steps.zh: 用入口智能体和用户输入启动一次运行

steps.en: Calls the model, runs requested tools, loops; a handoff switches the active agent
steps.zh: 调模型、执行要求的工具、循环；遇到交接就切换当前智能体

steps.en: Checks guardrails and stops at text with no tool calls, or at max_turns
steps.zh: 跑护栏检查；返回不含工具调用的文本或到 max_turns 时停止

steps.en: Returns final_output and records a trace of every model, tool and handoff step
steps.zh: 返回 final_output，并记下每次模型、工具、交接的追踪

value.en: A multi-agent loop with handoffs, guardrails and traces without writing the loop yourself
value.zh: 带交接、护栏和追踪的多智能体循环，不用自己写

sources: https://github.com/openai/openai-agents-python/blob/main/docs/handoffs.md (handoffs=[...]; handoffs appear to the LLM as transfer_to_<agent> tools)
